title: Barcelona aerobic + Montjuic climb
terrain: Barcelona, seafront + one Montjuic climb, ~150m D+

steps.target: Z2, 142-152bpm, one steady Montjuic climb in Z2

coachNotes:
EXECUTION: 55min at 142-152bpm including one steady Montjuic climb kept in Z2 (hike if HR goes over 152). Finish with 6x20s strides at 180+ spm, 1min walk. Morning before the 16:45 flight from BCN.
GYM: none.
FUEL: water.
GARMIN: ~60-80.
STOP RULE: under 6h sleep after the summit dinner, cut to 40min and skip the strides.
WHY: aerobic volume on a travel day; strides keep turnover after Tuesday's hill reps.
